commands.coverage: Actual in-memory BetterAuth setup, signed Cookie lookup, missing/invalid Cookie, Bearer non-substitution, sign-out revocation

coverage: Unmodified createApp, attachIdentity, Store and all original route registration
Actual setup and invitation APIs create two ephemeral BetterAuth members
Original Host, Origin and client-header guards remain active
Concurrent requests retain session-derived owners; spoofed header/body ownership and cross-owner writes cannot succeed
Endpoint, capability and scoped grant APIs expose the capability as discoverable but non-callable
Actual signed browser Cookie and independent Agent Bearer are not interchangeable; mixed credentials, Origin, query and out-of-scope project are rejected
Current project role downgrade invalidates previously issued Agent credential and hides the grant
Sign-out invalidates the real Cookie on Agent resource management

boundaries: Two isolated in-memory SQLite databases; ephemeral fake accounts and random test-only secrets
Fastify.inject only; no HTTP listener, public binding, external request or real account
Team mode disables NativeRuntime and does not call native.initialize; empty continuation table cannot dispatch work
No model, native runner, file-apply/restore diagnostic, identity late-response diagnostic, browser or full original test suite run
This validates server registration and authentication integration, not a real external Agent interoperability or remote deployment milestone
No production source edits or publication
